news.h: 2026 NFL trade deadline: Proposing deals for Tony Pollard, Riq Woolen, others
news.d: Our NFL experts pitched trade offers they'd love to see get done before Tuesday's deadline, including moves for Tony Pollard, Riq Woolen, Jonathan Taylor and Jessie Bates III.

news.h: Bengals face Falcons S Jessie Bates III, evoking mixed emotions
news.d: Cincinnati hasn't been to the playoffs since Bates' departure, but Atlanta also hasn't reached the postseason since his arrival.
